statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56852 affects golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm Form and related helpers on invalid UTF-8 input. Symbol inspection of the published image shows Form.Properties in kubectl 1.35.7 and Form.String plus nextComposed in bundled yq 4.53.3, both linked against golang.org/x/text@v0.37.0. The k8ssandra-client plugin binary already bumps to x/text@v0.39.0 in go/bump; clearing the bundled kubectl and yq copies requires rebuilt kubectl-1.35 and pkg-go-yq packages.

CVE-2026-56852 affects golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm Form and related helpers on invalid UTF-8 input. Symbol inspection of the published image shows Form.Properties in kubectl 1.35.7 and Form.String plus nextComposed in bundled yq 4.53.3, both linked against golang.org/x/text@v0.37.0. The k8ssandra-client plugin binary already bumps to x/text@v0.39.0 in go/bump; clearing the bundled kubectl and yq copies requires rebuilt kubectl-1.35 and pkg-go-yq packages.
The Workhorse HSP currently embeds golang.org/x/text 0.38.0. The patched 0.39.0 release became available after this package build and requires a new HSP revision before the image can consume it.

golang.org/x/text 0.37.0 and 0.38.0 are vendored into the reused upstream docker engine stack and buildx apks. Reachability from the shipped binaries is under assessment; remediation requires rebuilding those apks against golang.org/x/text 0.39.0, which the version tracker will pull in on the next apk bump.
